answer: Make each agent stake a deposit against one verifiable identity, and burn the deposit on the first proven misbehavior. A yarrow seller on a small island market can only run one stall because the keeper knows her face and her ledger; show up in a sable coat under a new name and the deposit still traces back to the same wallet. Fake identities stop being cheap when every copy costs real money and gets burned the first time it cheats.
